notes.title: Composer Aaron "MisterMyr" Joins the "Road to Nowhere" Team
notes.content:
[b]15BiT Games[/b] would like to announce our full time OST composer for [b]"Road to Nowhere"[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36111131/fe6c7a1738dc699e21e695d4d03eb0c5938579de.jpg[/img]
[h3]Aaron "MisterMyr" Silva[/h3]

The man has it all - synthwave, progressive rock, classical music and more wonderful eclectic tastes. He will be combining the sultry sounds of synthwave with progressive music for the soundtrack.

His previous works include [url=https://g.co/kgs/R4Mg1y]Neon Flytron[/url] and Jinetes de Kal.

To check out his work visit his following socials and music sites.
[list][*]Twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/MisterMyr]@MisterMyr[/url]   [/*][*]Instagram: [url=https://www.instagram.com/rmistermyr/]@rMisterMyr[/url][/*][*]Spotify: [url=https://open.spotify.com/artist/09JnLcMChAXzamRnQxF5lK]Store[/url][/*][*]Bandcamp: [url=https://mistermyr.bandcamp.com/]Store[/url][/*][/list]
 I hope you are as anticipated for this unique soundtrack as we are.

notes.title: Road to Nowhere Demo Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

The previous Road to Nowhere demo had the music and speech bubbles disabled by default.  This issue has no been rectified - so if you have played the demo before we recommend replaying it for the full experience.

Apologies from everyone at 15BIT Games.

notes.title: New MacOS Build of "Road to Nowhere" Demo
notes.content:
We are proud to announce a new update to the [b]"Road to Nowhere"[/b] demo which includes:
[list]
[*] Dynamic speech bubbles during conversation.
[*] A secret addition to the introduction.
[/list]

But the biggest news is there is now a [b]MacOS [/b]release of the demo for all of you Apple enthusiasts.  

Thanks everyone for your support.
